newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Blue Star to buy Australia's Link Printing.
newsitem.headline: Blue Star to buy Australia's Link Printing.

text.p: Blue Star Group said on Friday it had bought Australian commercial printer Link Printing Pty Ltd.
No sum was disclosed but the deal involved a mix of cash and the issue of shares in Blue Star's parent U.S. Offfice Products.
Blue Star ceo Eric Watson said Link was a natural match with its recent purchase of McCollam Printers Ltd.
Link employed 80 staff and had A$20 million annual turnover.
Blue Star now had annualised turnover of over NZ$1.3 billion.
USOP has been a highly active acquirer of companies since its float in February 1995. It has completed more than 165 acquisitions with current annualised sales of around US$3.2 billion.
